notes: Scenes for the scene mode (council P7, plan/kurul-2026-11-05-manzara.json). Rough prototype: one scene, the garden. Rects are in scene pixels on a square scene of 'size'. A slot is a fixed place where a piece sits; slots never overlap. A piece names its own slot; a tap sends it there, or to the nearest free slot when another piece took it. 'big' slots and pieces exist only in Büyük. The words are chosen by hand (house, not home; flower, not tulip); the catalog's names are not used. 'tr' is written as it is spoken at the start of a sentence. The ground words are the regions of the background drawing. Piece art comes from the bundled coloring pages, outlined again at the slot size. Build with: python3 tool/scenes/build_scenes.py
